reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its observable purpose is to teach viewers how to build a WordPress coupon-and-deal site and related Android application using affiliate programs. The stated Rs 3000 starting-site call to action and earnings figures are presented within a tutorial about website construction, hosting, retailer pages, and affiliate-link setup, without a supported claim of guaranteed returns or a demonstrated deceptive transaction. The offer's fulfillment and terms cannot be independently established from the supplied records, so they remain promotional claims rather than evidence of deception.

citations.quote: So to create a website, you'll need a domain name, a web hosting, wordpress and some plugins for wordpress. So step by step I'll tell you.
So first we choose a free theme for this coupon and deal website.
And here we insert that home page in the affiliate link generator. And here we will generate the affiliate link.
I wrote an article on earningbaba.com on the same topic. You can go to that article and find out all about it in detail.

opening.argument: The video directly links a claimed income outcome to the viewer's action of creating the same kind of application and website. The speaker says he will explain what he earns and then invites viewers to create one like it, followed by the stated Amazon earnings figure. The visual call to action makes the relationship explicit: start the coupon site for Rs 3000. This is not merely discussion of affiliate marketing; it presents a paid or effort-intensive step as the route toward an income opportunity.

citations.quote: we will tell you how much I earn from my Android application couponslay and its website couponslay.com. And if you also want to create an Android application and a website like this.
And I get about 8 to 10,000 from Amazon's affiliate program. So let's talk about how to do it.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a tutorial does not remove the solicitation. The opening itself acknowledges an earnings figure and a stated Rs 3000 start-site call to action. The technical steps explain how to enter the opportunity; they do not establish that the income claim is substantiated or that the viewer can realistically obtain the advertised result.

citations.quote: And if you also want to create an Android application and a website like this.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited excerpts show an income topic and an invitation to build a similar site, but they do not show a guaranteed return, a required payment to the speaker, or a deceptive transaction. The stated Rs 3000 appears in a promotional visual, while the spoken material primarily explains hosting, WordPress, pages, and affiliate-link setup.

citations.quote: So to create a website, you'll need a domain name, a web hosting, wordpress and some plugins for wordpress. So step by step I'll tell you.
And here we insert that home page in the affiliate link generator. And here we will generate the affiliate link.

opening.argument: Several risk signals reinforce the solicitation: a personal earnings claim, a specific monthly Amazon figure, and a visual instruction to start a coupon site at Rs 3000. The speaker also contrasts Amazon with another program's cap before presenting the Amazon amount, encouraging the viewer to treat the opportunity as financially attractive. The combination of a concrete return figure and a concrete starting-price call to action supports reading this as a low-barrier income pitch, not neutral technical education.

citations.quote: Like if this month's cap is 19,000. So no matter how much more I make than 19,000. 30,000 or 40,000. I'm going to get 19,000.
There's no cap in Amazon's affiliate program. And I get about 8 to 10,000 from Amazon's affiliate program.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the earnings figure as incidental, but the speaker pauses to compare caps and quantify Amazon income, while the visual supplies a concrete entry price. Those are precisely the details that make the commercial promise persuasive. A lack of independently proven deception cannot turn a combined income claim and action prompt into ordinary instruction.

citations.quote: 30,000 or 40,000. I'm going to get 19,000.
And I get about 8 to 10,000 from Amazon's affiliate program.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are genuine promotional signals, but they remain claims rather than proof of a scam. The cap comparison describes affiliate-program limits, and the Amazon figure is presented as the speaker's earnings, not as a promise that viewers will receive the same amount. The visual call to start a site does not establish what the Rs 3000 buys or whether any transaction is deceptive.

citations.quote: So no matter how much more I make than 19,000. 30,000 or 40,000. I'm going to get 19,000.
And I get about 8 to 10,000 from Amazon's affiliate program.

opening.argument: The apparent tutorial framing functions as promotion for an income-making package and its associated destinations. The description calls this an easy way to earn money online and directs viewers to create a coupon website, while the video repeatedly supplies affiliate-program, hosting, plugin, and app-building pathways. It also promotes a paid plugin and external article. The educational steps therefore serve to move viewers from curiosity about earnings toward purchasing tools or following external links to begin the proposed business.

citations.quote: If you want to create Coupon website in WordPress to Earn money online with Affiliate marketing then in this post I am going to share you Easy way to earn money online
Affiliate Egg Pro is a premium plugin that you have to buy. Content Egg you can use for free.
I wrote an article on earningbaba.com on the same topic. You can go to that article and find out all about it in detail.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense emphasizes the mechanics while omitting how those mechanics are embedded in an earning pitch. The description explicitly calls the method an easy way to earn money, and the video directs viewers to external resources and a premium plugin. That commercial steering is relevant even if the presenter also demonstrates real WordPress operations.

citations.quote: Easy way to earn money online
Affiliate Egg Pro is a premium plugin that you have to buy.
You can go to that article and find out all about it in detail.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion does not itself establish a scam. The description and video identify ordinary tools and affiliate workflows, and the premium plugin is expressly identified as something to buy rather than hidden. The cited article and links may support promotion, but they do not show false credentials, guaranteed earnings, or that viewers lose money after following the instructions.
